premise: Crab tries to walk straight ahead to visit Starfish and tips over; Hermit Crab tells him crab legs bend sideways, and off he zips.
inspiration: Kipling's 'Just So' how-the-animal-got-its-ways tale, turned true: the reason is how crab legs are made, and the tumble is the funny part.
lesson: The way you are made is the way that works for you.
learning: Crabs walk sideways because their legs bend sideways.

en-US.title: Why Crab Walks Sideways
en-US.text: {crab:enter} {crab:go to rocks} Crab sat up on the rocks. Down in the pool stood {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish, on two of her five orange arms. She {starfish:live wave} waved hello. {crab:face happy} Crab wanted to go and see her the way everybody does: straight ahead. [playfully] One step forward. {crab:wobble} Wobble! Two steps forward. {crab:spin} Oops! His legs got all in a tangle, and over he went, upside down. {sfx:clatter solo} {crab:face surprised} Along came {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to crab} Hermit Crab, carrying his striped shell. {hermit-crab:face surprised} [curious] Why are you walking frontwards? he asked. {hermit-crab:live talk} Crab legs bend sideways. That's the way they're made! {crab:face happy} {crab:live nod} So Crab tried it. {sfx:click} Click, click, sideways… {crab:go to starfish} zip! He was there in a moment. {starfish:live jump} {crab:live dance} Crab clicked his claws and did a happy sideways dance. {hermit-crab:hearts} [happily] And crabs have gone sideways ever since.

es-ES.title: Por qué Cangrejo va de lado
es-ES.text: {crab:enter} {crab:go to rocks} Cangrejo estaba sentado en las rocas. Abajo, en la charca, estaba {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella, sobre dos de sus cinco brazos naranjas. Ella {starfish:live wave} lo saludó. {crab:face happy} Cangrejo quería ir a verla como todo el mundo: hacia delante. [playfully] Un paso adelante. {crab:wobble} ¡Tambaleo! Dos pasos adelante. {crab:spin} ¡Huy! Se le enredaron las patas y se dio la vuelta, boca arriba. {sfx:clatter solo} {crab:face surprised} Entonces llegó {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to crab} Cangrejo Ermitaño, con su concha de rayas a cuestas. {hermit-crab:face surprised} [curious] ¿Por qué andas hacia delante?, preguntó. {hermit-crab:live talk} Las patas de los cangrejos se doblan de lado. ¡Están hechas así! {crab:face happy} {crab:live nod} Así que Cangrejo lo probó. {sfx:click} Clic, clic, de lado… {crab:go to starfish} ¡zas! Llegó en un momento. {starfish:live jump} {crab:live dance} Cangrejo chocó las pinzas y bailó de lado, muy contento. {hermit-crab:hearts} [happily] Y desde entonces, los cangrejos van de lado.

ja-JP.title: カニくんは なぜ よこあるき？
ja-JP.text: {crab:enter}{crab:go to rocks}カニくんは、岩の上にすわっていました。下の潮だまりには、{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}ヒトデさん。五本のうでのうち、二本で立っています。{starfish:live wave}「こんにちは」 と手をふりました。{crab:face happy}カニくんは、みんなとおなじように、まっすぐまえにあるいて、あいにいくことに。[playfully]まえに、いっぽ。{crab:wobble}ぐらっ！まえに、にほ。{crab:spin}おっとっと！あしがこんがらがって、ころん。ひっくりかえっちゃった。{sfx:clatter solo}{crab:face surprised}そこへ、{hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to crab}ヤドカリくんが、しましまのかいがらをしょって、やってきました。{hermit-crab:face surprised}[curious]「どうして、まえにあるいてるの？」 とヤドカリくん。{hermit-crab:live talk}「カニのあしは、よこにまがるんだよ。そういうふうに、できてるの！」 {crab:face happy}{crab:live nod}そこで、カニくんは、やってみました。{sfx:click}カサカサッ、よこへ…{crab:go to starfish}シューッ！あっというまに、とうちゃく。{starfish:live jump}{crab:live dance}カニくんは、はさみをカチカチ。うれしい、よこあるきダンス。{hermit-crab:hearts}[happily]それからずっと、カニは、よこあるき。

de-DE.title: Warum die Krabbe seitwärts läuft
de-DE.text: {crab:enter} {crab:go to rocks} Die Krabbe saß oben auf den Felsen. Unten im Tümpel stand {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} der Seestern, auf zwei von seinen fünf orangen Armen. Er {starfish:live wave} winkte hallo. {crab:face happy} Die Krabbe wollte zu ihm hin, so wie alle anderen auch: geradeaus. [playfully] Ein Schritt nach vorn. {crab:wobble} Wackel! Zwei Schritte nach vorn. {crab:spin} Hoppla! Ihre Beine verhedderten sich, und schon lag sie auf dem Rücken. {sfx:clatter solo} {crab:face surprised} Da kam {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to crab} der Einsiedlerkrebs, sein gestreiftes Häuschen huckepack. {hermit-crab:face surprised} [curious] „Warum läufst du denn vorwärts?“, fragte er. {hermit-crab:live talk} „Krabbenbeine biegen sich zur Seite. So sind sie nun mal gebaut!“ {crab:face happy} {crab:live nod} Also probierte die Krabbe es aus. {sfx:click} Klick, klick, seitwärts… {crab:go to starfish} zack! Im Nu war sie da. {starfish:live jump} {crab:live dance} Die Krabbe klapperte mit den Scheren und tanzte einen fröhlichen Seitwärtstanz. {hermit-crab:hearts} [happily] Und seitdem laufen Krabben immer seitwärts.

fr-FR.title: Pourquoi Crabe marche de travers
fr-FR.text: {crab:enter} {crab:go to rocks} Crabe était assis sur les rochers. En bas, dans la mare, se tenait {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Étoile de mer, debout sur deux de ses cinq bras orange. Elle {starfish:live wave} lui a fait coucou. {crab:face happy} Crabe voulait aller la voir comme tout le monde : droit devant. [playfully] Un pas en avant. {crab:wobble} Ouh là, ça vacille ! Deux pas en avant. {crab:spin} Oups ! Ses pattes se sont emmêlées, et il s’est retrouvé sur le dos, les pattes en l’air. {sfx:clatter solo} {crab:face surprised} C’est alors qu’est arrivé {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to crab} Bernard-l’ermite, avec sa coquille à rayures sur le dos. {hermit-crab:face surprised} [curious] « Pourquoi tu marches tout droit ? » a-t-il demandé. {hermit-crab:live talk} « Les pattes des crabes se plient sur le côté. C’est comme ça qu’elles sont faites ! » {crab:face happy} {crab:live nod} Alors Crabe a essayé. {sfx:click} Clic, clic, de travers… {crab:go to starfish} zou ! Il est arrivé en un clin d’œil. {starfish:live jump} {crab:live dance} Crabe a fait claquer ses pinces, et il a dansé de joie, de côté. {hermit-crab:hearts} [happily] Et depuis ce jour-là, les crabes marchent de travers.

it-IT.title: Perché Granchio cammina di lato
it-IT.text: {crab:enter} {crab:go to rocks} Granchio se ne stava seduto sugli scogli. Giù nella pozza c'era {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Stella marina, ritta su due delle sue cinque braccia arancioni. {starfish:live wave} Gli ha fatto ciao. {crab:face happy} Granchio voleva andare da lei come fanno tutti: dritto davanti a sé. [playfully] Un passo avanti. {crab:wobble} Traballa! Due passi avanti. {crab:spin} Ops! Le zampe gli si sono tutte aggrovigliate, e patatrac, si è ribaltato a pancia all'aria. {sfx:clatter solo} {crab:face surprised} Ed ecco arrivare {hermit-crab:enter} {hermit-crab:go to crab} Paguro, con la sua conchiglia a strisce sulla schiena. {hermit-crab:face surprised} [curious] «Perché cammini in avanti?», gli ha chiesto. {hermit-crab:live talk} «Le zampe dei granchi si piegano di lato. Sono fatte così!» {crab:face happy} {crab:live nod} Così Granchio ci ha provato. {sfx:click} Clic, clic, di lato… {crab:go to starfish} zac! È arrivato in un attimo. {starfish:live jump} {crab:live dance} Granchio ha fatto clic clac con le chele e un balletto felice, tutto di lato. {hermit-crab:hearts} [happily] E da allora, i granchi camminano di lato.

zh-TW.title: 螃蟹為什麼橫著走
zh-TW.text: {crab:enter}{crab:go to rocks}螃蟹坐在高高的岩石上。下面的潮池裡，{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星正用兩隻橘色的手站著，牠一共有五隻手呢。牠{starfish:live wave}揮揮手，打招呼。{crab:face happy}螃蟹想過去找牠，像大家一樣，往前直直走。[playfully]往前一步。{crab:wobble}搖搖晃晃！往前兩步。{crab:spin}哎呀！牠的腳全都打結了，咕咚一聲，翻了個肚子朝天。{sfx:clatter solo}{crab:face surprised}這時候，{hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to crab}寄居蟹揹著牠的條紋殼走過來。{hermit-crab:face surprised}[curious]「你為什麼往前走呀？」 牠問。{hermit-crab:live talk}「螃蟹的腳是往旁邊彎的，天生就是這樣嘛！」 {crab:face happy}{crab:live nod}螃蟹就試試看。{sfx:click}喀、喀，往旁邊走……{crab:go to starfish}咻！一下子就到了。{starfish:live jump}{crab:live dance}螃蟹喀喀地夾著鉗子，開開心心地橫著跳起舞來。{hermit-crab:hearts}[happily]從此以後，螃蟹都橫著走。

zh-HK.title: 螃蟹為甚麼打橫走
zh-HK.text: {crab:enter}{crab:go to rocks}螃蟹坐在岩石上。下面的石池裏，站着{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星，牠五隻橙色的手，用兩隻來站。牠{starfish:live wave}揮手打招呼。{crab:face happy}螃蟹想過去找牠，就像大家一樣：直直向前走。[playfully]向前走一步。{crab:wobble}搖搖晃晃！向前走兩步。{crab:spin}哎吔！牠的腳全部纏在一起，一下子翻轉了，肚皮朝天。{sfx:clatter solo}{crab:face surprised}這時，{hermit-crab:enter}{hermit-crab:go to crab}寄居蟹背着牠的間條殼走過來。{hermit-crab:face surprised}[curious]「你做乜向前行呀？」 牠問。{hermit-crab:live talk}「螃蟹嘅腳係向兩邊屈嘅，天生就係噉㗎！」 {crab:face happy}{crab:live nod}於是，螃蟹試試看。{sfx:click}咔、咔，打橫走……{crab:go to starfish}咻！一下子就到了。{starfish:live jump}{crab:live dance}螃蟹咔咔地敲着鉗子，打橫跳起開心的舞來。{hermit-crab:hearts}[happily]從那天起，螃蟹就一直打橫走路了。
